newsitem.title: GERMANY: AP Lintas-owned German ad agency to restructure.
newsitem.headline: AP Lintas-owned German ad agency to restructure.

text.p: German advertising agency Baader, Lang, Behnken (BLB) plans a management and ownership reshuffle, its owner, advertising group AP Lintas, said on Thursday.

Retreating from statements they made in April that they wanted to buy the agency back from AP, both chief executives, Fred Baader and Wolfgang Behnken, now plan to leave the company by the end of the year and sell their shares, AP Lintas said.
"We are already negotiating with a new management team," AP Lintas spokeswoman Ursula Reimers said. "AP Lintas does not want to become the sole owner of BLB."
AP Lintas said in a statement that despite months of discussions with Baader and Behnken they were not able to prevent them from stepping down.
Baader told Reuters that he and the agency's three other managers decided to sell their BLB shares after negotiations failed and that he plans to open a new agency.
"Wolfgang Behnken and I intend to open our own ad agency in the beginning of 1998," Baader said. "I don't know the details yet."
AP Lintas, which currently has an 82 percent share of the agency, said it planned to maintain BLB as an independent entity and expected to annnounce final plans for the restructuring in mid-August.
BLB represented advertising volume of over 100 million marks in 1996.
